verdict.rationale: Speaker diarization is a fair question for a speech-to-text product, but neither the API docs nor the GitHub README document any diarization option or speaker-labeled output. Community reports say Whisper transcripts lack speaker labels and that users must bolt on external tools like pyannote or NeMo. That is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can request speaker diarization and the transcript labels who said what
